purpose: Additive GEN-006 persistent-area milestone questions, separate from the unchanged frozen retrieval evaluation.

questions.query: What does the three-area persistent authored-world prototype actually retain, and can it transfer Rapier actors or stream arbitrary chunks?
facts: The opt-in Draft/HOLD prototype retains full admitted native CYPS2 continuation and separate authored starting-map metadata for three 512 by 512 Current/FreeMass areas.
It retains explicit Empty edits, dynamic material and solver state, clocks, activity and supported native events; it does not restore only material IDs or a generator seed.

One active gameplay World remains authoritative. The conservative cache-disabled path uses one private candidate and inactive checkpoints; the stacked RAM-cache extension additionally retains unique-owned inactive HOT Worlds with fenced worker host companions. Unsupported host actors, Rapier, controllers, sources and external queues pin or refuse travel.
The editor/camera is the traveller. General streaming, arbitrary selective eviction and recipe reconciliation in GEN-006 #194 remain outside the #591 milestone.

questions.query: How do persistent area catch-up and Simulate Ahead avoid double-running game time, and what happens when the budget or cancellation interrupts them?
facts: Only actual completed native ticks advance time. Active progression increments global and area time; catch-up pays existing area debt without advancing global time again.
Simulate Ahead pays debt first and then adds only completed future ticks. Unperformed requested future duration is not elapsed time.

Operations admit at most 600 ticks and a three-second native-work budget, with slices of at most 32 ticks and 100 ms checked between indivisible ticks. Additional capture/storage/restore latency is reported separately.

Coarse idle skipping is refused and grants zero credit because native scheduled deadlines and epoch changes defeat the proposed quiescence shortcut. Cancellation preserves proven completed work and exposes remaining debt.

questions.query: How do I evaluate persistent areas on Windows, recover after a failed save, and distinguish native persistence from ordinary Save start or Flatten?
facts: The portable evaluator has separate Persistent Areas and ordinary Workbench launchers, pinned Godot and native runtime, and an isolated writable profile.
Save all areas retains evolved native continuation; ordinary Save start and Flatten retain their existing authored material-start meanings.
Immutable generation blobs and a manifest-last transaction preserve the prior state; uncertain publication is quarantined and must be reopened, while corruption never silently resets a seed.
Automated graphical smoke uses a separate profile and a genuinely new process. Target-OS software-rendered evidence does not establish physical Windows 11/NVIDIA owner acceptance.
